To play from outside your home network, you need a tunnel. This app uses playit.gg: you can activate the agent from your phone without a computer, or paste the agent secret obtained from the website or computer. The secret stays on your phone, protected by Android Keystore.

To play from outside your home network, you need a tunnel: playit.gg receives player connections and forwards them to the server on your phone. An agent runs on the phone and is identified by a secret. There are two ways to set it up.
Set up on the phone, without a computer

1) On the External connection screen, tap “Activate agent from phone”.\n2) A playit.gg/claim/… page opens in your browser. Sign in to your account or create one, then approve the agent.\n3) Return to the app without closing it. The secret will arrive and be saved automatically, without copying anything. You will see “Secret saved automatically”.

1) Install playit-cli on the computer and run playit-cli setup. The program displays a playit.gg/claim/… link to approve in the browser.\n2) The secret is in C:\\ProgramData\\playit_gg\\playit.toml, on the line named secret_key. Copy only the long hexadecimal value between the quotation marks. On Linux, the file is /etc/playit/playit.toml; the playit-cli secret-path command prints its exact location.\n3) Paste the value into the “Paste the playit.gg agent secret” field and tap “Save secret”.
The activation code is not the secret

The short 10-character code in the playit.gg/claim/ address is only for approving the agent in the browser; it is not the secret. If you paste it into the secret field, the app recognizes it and warns you.

1) Tap Start agent. The notification should show Tunnel active and the log should show Agent started.\n2) Create a tunnel in the playit.gg dashboard: choose Minecraft Java and local port 25565, or the port used by your server.\n3) Share the address shown next to the server name. Friends enter it in Minecraft as a normal multiplayer server.
If the log shows “Could not reach the playit API”, check the network connection, then stop and start the agent again.
If no address appears after tapping Read addresses, the tunnel may not be assigned yet or may be disabled. Check the playit.gg website.
If phone activation does not finish or the code expires, tap the button again. Each attempt creates a new code.
Phone activation creates a new agent on your account. If you already had a working agent with an assigned tunnel, check on playit.gg which agent the tunnel uses.
The tunnel works only while the agent is active. If you restart the phone or stop the agent, start it again before playing.
